ordered_diagnoses: Immune-Related Adverse Event (irAE) from PD-L1 inhibitor

s1.syndrome_frame: Sudden vision loss in one eye with optic disc swelling and retinal changes
salient_findings: Sudden vision loss in the right eye
Marked swelling of the optic disc
Occlusion of the superior branch artery
key_facts: Patient is a woman in her 40s
Presented with blurred vision in the right eye
Undergoing treatment with systemic steroids, durvalumab, and bevacizumab
Developed sudden vision loss in the right eye 10 days after initial presentation
Initial visual acuity was 20/25 OU
Right eye showed full visual field and relative afferent pupillary defect
Mild swelling of the optic disc was noted on initial examination
Follow-up examination showed no light perception vision in the right eye
Imaging studies showed focal enhancement along enlarged right optic nerve
Vitreous biopsy showed hypercellular sample with astrocytic neoplasm

shortlist: Immune-Related Adverse Event (irAE) from PD-L1 inhibitor

shortlist.label: Optic Nerve Glioma
shortlist.why_kept: Vitreous biopsy showed hypercellular sample with astrocytic neoplasm, consistent with glioma

shortlist.label: Intraocular Lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Vitreous biopsy showed hypercellular sample, and patient is undergoing treatment with immunosuppressive therapy

shortlist.label: Immune-Related Adverse Event (irAE) from PD-L1 inhibitor
shortlist.why_kept: Patient is undergoing treatment with durvalumab, a PD-L1 inhibitor, which can cause irAEs

shortlist.label: Central Retinal Artery Occlusion
shortlist.why_kept: Patient developed sudden vision loss and imaging studies showed lack of perfusion of retinal vasculature

shortlist.label: Optic Neuritis
shortlist.why_kept: Patient presented with blurred vision, relative afferent pupillary defect, and optic disc swelling, consistent with optic neuritis

raw.rationale: Vitreous biopsy showed hypercellular sample with astrocytic neoplasm, which is consistent with Optic Nerve Glioma

rejected.label: Intraocular Lymphoma
rejected.why: No evidence of lymphoma cells in vitreous biopsy

rejected.label: Immune-Related Adverse Event (irAE) from PD-L1 inhibitor
rejected.why: While patient is on durvalumab, biopsy results suggest a neoplastic process rather than an immune-related adverse event

rejected.label: Central Retinal Artery Occlusion
rejected.why: Although patient developed occlusion of the central retinal artery, the primary issue is the optic nerve glioma

rejected.label: Optic Neuritis
rejected.why: Optic neuritis typically presents with pain and decreased vision, but biopsy results indicate a neoplastic process rather than inflammation
